summary: Backend + frontend testing of SELF/patient family flow bug fix. Backend: 6/6 new pytest cases pass (own-list scoping, PATCH/DELETE ownership+403, medical_history/allergies persistence, SOS triage does NOT create referrals for patient user, Hindi/English specialty). Frontend Playwright: 20/22 checks pass covering the exact review requirements — patient login lands on /me (family-heading 'Who needs help today?'), '+ Add Family Member' opens /me/add with data-testid=family-form and no referral/hospital-selection/AI-match controls, creating Kamla Devi Mother 62 female shows a new family-card back on /me with 'Mother · 62 yrs', logout→re-login retains the record, family-profile shows use-medmatch / edit / remove buttons, Use MedMatch opens /me/:id/help with BOTH problem-text-input AND voice-input-button visible together (voice click does not crash), Hindi 'सीने में दर्द' → Cardiologist and English 'skin problem' → Dermatologist with intake-hospital-card-0 + intake-map-link-0 rendering, emergency-help-button shows emergency-banner 'Emergency assistance for Kamla Devi …' with call-108-button and creates NO referral (GET /api/referrals count unchanged: 0→0), /asha/patients & /asha/patients/new both redirect the patient to home, and Hindi toggle translates 'Who needs help today?' → 'आज किसे मदद चाहिए?' and add card → '+ परिजन जोड़ें'. No referral text appears anywhere inside the family-form itself (the word only appears in the shared top-nav 'My Referrals' link which is expected).

integration_issues.issue: On /me/:id/help the intake-heading briefly renders 'How can we help ?' with no name because `person` from /api/patients/{id} has not resolved yet. Heading gains name only after GET completes. Consider showing a skeleton until person is loaded, or rendering label from cached list to avoid the blank name flash.

action_items: Optional: prevent brief empty-name flash on /me/:id/help intake-heading by awaiting person GET before rendering the heading (or pass name via state).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/patients.py list_patients: ASHA is scoped to own records — the review spec says only 'patient' should be self-scoped; ASHA CARE role typically needs to see all patients they handle. Current code filters ASHA too. Confirm this is intended (may break ASHA workflows if they used to see shared cohort).

FamilyForm.jsx: initial default relationship is 'mother' — if user opens '/me/add?relationship=self' from Home ('Me' setup card) it works via searchParams. But when navigating directly to /me/add (typing URL), 'mother' is silently defaulted; add explicit placeholder like 'Select relationship' to force choice for correctness.
ProblemIntake.jsx: heading label falls back to '' before GET resolves → briefly shows 'How can we help ?' (no name). Render heading only after person loads or reuse cached name from list.
FamilyForm.jsx: age defaults to 30 before GET fills in on edit → a fast Save press could overwrite the real age with 30. Guard submit until initial GET populates.
ProblemIntake.jsx line 61: symptoms/severity PATCH is fire-and-forget with .catch(() => {}) — silently swallows errors; at minimum log.

There is a leftover TEST record 'bhavy · Other · 25 yrs' under the patient account (noted in review). Consider a one-time cleanup script or seed migration to drop non-seeded test rows if desired (harmless otherwise).

success_rate.frontend: ~91% (20/22 checks; 2 failures are test-timing artefacts, not real bugs)

test_credentials: patient@sanjeevani.in/Patient@2026, asha@sanjeevani.in/Asha@2026, hospital@sanjeevani.in/Hosp@2026 (all working; httpOnly cookie auth)
seed_data_creation: Test playwright run creates and deletes 'Kamla Devi TEST <ts>' at the end (cleanup passes). Backend pytest creates TEST_-prefixed patients and deletes them at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SELF/patient family flow is fully working end-to-end. Bug from prior iteration ('Add Patient' behaving like referral creation) is fixed — /me/add is a plain family form. All backend routes (patients/sos/referrals) behave correctly for the patient role: scoped list, 403 on cross-user PATCH/DELETE, SOS triage never creates referrals. Route protection redirects patient off /asha/*. i18n translates the new pages. Only minor UX polish left: heading flash and age-default guard on FamilyForm edit.
